name: module_single_load_20261025
comment: ANCHOR: MODULE_SINGLE_LOAD_20261025 — portfolio-server loads each own module once: a meta-path finder (scripts/lib/module_single_load.py, installed by portfolio_server.py as __main__) returns the already-loaded module for lib.X / scripts.lib.X / bare X spellings, so caches, locks and classes are not split across copies.
